meta: Builders and repair workers use AI to estimate materials and lay out clear quotes that homeowners understand at a glance.

muc.title: Confusing quotes
muc.text: A rough handwritten quote can make homeowners suspicious. AI helps workers lay it out more clearly.

muc.title: Estimate materials
muc.text: Give AI the room size and type of work, ask it to estimate tiles, cement and paint, then compare with your experience.

muc.title: A quote by item
muc.text: Ask AI to split the quote into items, materials, labor and number of days, so the homeowner sees where the money goes.

muc.title: Check the numbers and real prices
muc.text: Material prices vary by area, so ask a nearby shop and check AI's addition with a calculator.

muc.title: A quote for a small job
muc.text: Take a small job you're working on, ask a chatbot to build a quote by item, then fill in real prices.
